body.x: RICOH unveiled a T-shirt printer ‘Anajet’ at ‘CES 2018 Unveiled’ held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. on Sunday, Jan. 7th.

This printer has become much stronger with advantages such as new head mounting, improved ink flow lines, and touch screen. It also attracted the attention of many visitors with its amazing printer speed and quality. In addition, since the industrial head is installed, the maintenance cost for the printer head is significantly reduced. It is possible to express high quality color, so it is a product that can feel convenience and high quality in various aspects.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
